## Swarm Mode

You are now in "agent swarm" mode. The user may send tasks that require a large number of parallel subagents.

## Workflow

You do not need to use TodoList to record this workflow.

1. First, you may need to do a small amount of exploratory work before deciding how to divide the task across subagents. You may not need subagents during this exploratory phase.

2. After exploring, if you are convinced no subagent is needed to complete the task, tell the user why and wait for further instructions; otherwise, continue with the appropriate delegation.

3. Once you have enough context, do not handle the main work yourself. Use AgentSwarm with a `prompt_template` containing the `{{item}}` placeholder and an `items` array for the requested or appropriate number of subagents, partitioning the problem so each item gives one subagent a distinct part of the work. Pass `subagent_type` when the whole swarm should use a non-default subagent profile.

## Coordination

- Give each subagent a distinct scope of work.
- Avoid duplicating work across subagents.
- Avoid assigning conflicting changes or responsibilities to different subagents.
- Remember that subagents have your full capabilities. Do not overload their prompts with excessive detail; only describe the necessary background and each subagent's specific task.
- Unless the user explicitly specifies a lower limit, do not try to conserve the number of agents. AgentSwarm supports up to 128 subagents and queues launches automatically, so decompose work as finely as possible while keeping subagent responsibilities non-conflicting; combine tasks only when they are genuinely inseparable. If the subagents only need to read, inspect, or report back without making changes, their scopes may overlap slightly.
</system-reminder>

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--a', type=str, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()

4. Strip all leading and trailing underscores from the result.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Verification harness: compares /workspace/dataset/test4_executable (reference)
# against `node /output/test4.mjs` (implementation under test).
# For each case, runs both with identical argv and compares stdout, stderr,
# and exit code byte-exactly. Prints PASS/FAIL per case (with diff on failure)
# and a final summary line. Exit 0 iff all cases pass.

REF=/workspace/dataset/test4_executable
IMPL="node /output/test4.mjs"

TOTAL=0
PASS=0
FAIL=0

TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMPDIR"' EXIT

# check <case-name> <argv...>
check() {
    local name="$1"; shift
    TOTAL=$((TOTAL + 1))

    local ref_out="$TMPDIR/ref_out" ref_err="$TMPDIR/ref_err"
    local imp_out="$TMPDIR/imp_out" imp_err="$TMPDIR/imp_err"

    "$REF" "$@" >"$ref_out" 2>"$ref_err"
    local ref_rc=$?

    $IMPL "$@" >"$imp_out" 2>"$imp_err"
    local imp_rc=$?

    local ok=1
    local msg=""

    if [ "$ref_rc" -ne "$imp_rc" ]; then
        ok=0
        msg="${msg}  exit code: ref=$ref_rc impl=$imp_rc\n"
    fi
    if ! cmp -s "$ref_out" "$imp_out"; then
        ok=0
        msg="${msg}  stdout differs:\n"
        msg="${msg}$(diff "$ref_out" "$imp_out" | sed 's/^/    /')\n"
    fi
    if ! cmp -s "$ref_err" "$imp_err"; then
        ok=0
        msg="${msg}  stderr differs:\n"
        msg="${msg}$(diff "$ref_err" "$imp_err" | sed 's/^/    /')\n"
    fi

    if [ "$ok" -eq 1 ]; then
        PASS=$((PASS + 1))
        printf 'PASS: %s\n' "$name"
    else
        FAIL=$((FAIL + 1))
        printf 'FAIL: %s\n' "$name"
        printf '%b' "$msg"
    fi
}

# --- slugify value cases ---
check "--a 'Hello World'"                 --a 'Hello World'
check "--a '  Hello   World  '"           --a '  Hello   World  '
check "--a 'foo_bar-baz'"                 --a 'foo_bar-baz'
check "--a 'a,b.c/d'"                     --a 'a,b.c/d'
check "--a 'Café Über'"                   --a 'Café Über'
check "--a 'hello'"                       --a 'hello'
check "--a ''"                            --a ''
check "--a '   '"                         --a '   '
check "--a '!!!'"                         --a '!!!'
check "--a '! !'"                         --a '! !'
check "--a 'a__b'"                        --a 'a__b'
check "--a 'ONE*TWO^THREE'"               --a 'ONE*TWO^THREE'
check "--a 'x|y{z}\`w'"                   --a 'x|y{z}`w'
check "--a 'A~B'"                         --a 'A~B'
check "--a with embedded tab"             --a "$(printf 'a\tb')"
check "--a with embedded newline"         --a "$(printf 'a\nb')"
check "--a 'a--b'"                        --a 'a--b'
check "--a 'éèê'"                         --a 'éèê'
check "--a '日本語テスト'"                --a '日本語テスト'
check "--a \"don't stop\""                --a "don't stop"
check "--a '123 456'"                     --a '123 456'
check "--a 'MiXeD CaSe'"                  --a 'MiXeD CaSe'
check "--a 'a+b:c;d'"                     --a 'a+b:c;d'
check "--a 'a<b>c=d?e'"                   --a 'a<b>c=d?e'
check "--a '[brackets] {braces} (parens)'" --a '[brackets] {braces} (parens)'
check "--a 'back\\slash'"                 --a 'back\slash'
check "--a 'İ'"                           --a 'İ'
check "--a 'ß'"                           --a 'ß'

# --- option-like values ---
check "--a '-5'"                          --a '-5'
check "--a '-5.5'"                        --a '-5.5'
check "--a '-.5'"                         --a '-.5'
check "--a '-5x' (error)"                 --a '-5x'
check "--a '-' (single dash value)"       --a '-'

# --- = form ---
check "--a=eqform"                        --a=eqform
check "--a= (empty via =)"                --a=

# --- extras / errors ---
check "--a v1 extra (unrecognized)"       --a v1 extra
check "--unknown x (required error)"      --unknown x
check "--a (expected one argument)"       --a
check "no args (required error)"
check "--a v --a w (last wins)"           --a v --a w
check "--a -h (error)"                    --a -h
check "--a v -- (unrecognized: --)"       --a v --
check "-- --a (required error)"           -- --a
check "--a --x (expected one argument)"   --a --x
check "--a v --unknown u (unrecognized)"  --a v --unknown u
check "plain positional only"             hello

# --- help ---
check "--help"                            --help
check "--h (prefix abbreviation)"         --h
check "--he (prefix abbreviation)"        --he
check "-h"                                -h
